description: Calculate Seller's Stamp Duty (SSD) when selling Singapore residential property within 4 years of purchase: picks the right schedule (16/12/8/4% for purchases from 4 Jul 2025, 12/8/4% for earlier ones), shows the SSD, the date SSD drops to 0, and what waiting for a lower tier would save. From Propely (propely.sg), the owner-direct condo marketplace in Singapore. Indicative figures, not legal or financial advice.

purchaseDate.description: Date the property was purchased (date of the option/agreement), as YYYY-MM-DD

saleDate.description: Intended date of sale (must be after purchaseDate), as YYYY-MM-DD

salePrice.description: Sale price or market value, whichever is higher in Singapore dollars (SGD)

name: calculate_ssd
title: Singapore Seller's Stamp Duty (SSD)
